name: io.github.terry2010/surfbird-mcp
description: MCP server for Surfbird — the self-hosted Kitesurf headless browser. Article-to-markdown extraction, rendered HTML, screenshots, PDFs, in-page JS evaluation and batch fetching for AI agents and RSS digests.

environmentVariables.name: SURFBIRD_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Surfbird auth-image REST proxy

environmentVariables.name: SURFBIRD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token matching SURFBIRD_TOKEN on the container
